notes: SOURCE: endless WWI-like battlefield, only the abandoned trench system accessible; complex Euclidean layout with random twists; planks, corroded iron sheets, worn sandbags, rusted barbed wire; narrow paths to wide gun emplacements, artillery stations with mortars of non-human make, damp bunkers (some collapsed) with beds, tables, chairs, uniforms, ammunition crates, rations; thick damp soil; eerie silence and distant gunfire; leaving the trench = precise headshot; escalating fire; rare bombers and L.E.A.D.S.; shells at random; day and night twice Frontrooms length, less gunfire at night; sudden dense fog; rare storms flooding to waist level, lightning -> Level 3, flooded tunnel -> Level 7; half-empty Almond Water, canned food, used medical kits, uniforms, empty rifles, notes and books; M.E.G. Gutter Bunkers (three connected bunkers) whose specific rusted doors lead to Levels 14, 65 and 50; Entity 49/1 Trenchcleaner; letters, logs, test log, report (TESTIMONY). ADAPTATION: streamed 32 m chunks of 2 m cells carved into zig-zag trenches (row 0 a continuous fire trench, every third column a communication trench, other edges random) with per-chunk features (covered emplacement with a 1 m fire-step, artillery pit, dugout bunker, collapsed dugout); trench floor 2.4 m below ground with sandbag parapets; dugouts 2.8 m lower; chunk (0,0) is the Gutter Bunkers: three dugouts joined by a tunnel, each with a rusted back door (L14, L65, L50; L049>L065#2 added from data/canon/transitions.json) and a jammed side door, and a grated drainage culvert. Parapet rule: eyes above ground level for 0.7 s -> fatal shot (a crack past the ear at 0.25 s). Time: 80-minute day/night cycle; fog 4-8 min; storm 5 min with a flood rising to waist height (dugouts fill), lightning near the player (2 s warning; struck -> L003), the culvert grate gives way above 0.8 m of water and the tunnel exit (L007) exists only then; shells every 45-130 s, a bomber every 18-28 min (hurts the upright and uncovered). Trenchcleaner: one scripted presence every 6-12 min that stalks along the trenches to ~13 m, sweeps and withdraws; it fires a burst only with a clear line of sight to a moving, upright or lit player (40 damage); never fought. The L666 edge (killing a wanderer) is not implemented: there are no other wanderers. QA: weather, shelling and the Trenchcleaner are off in QA mode; the bot fires the L014 door. Canon: docs/canon/levels/L049.md; author exotichive credited there under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not yet PLAYABLE.
